wt.title: 🎯 Winning Technique Analysis
wt.description: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this shows which winning techniques (Nige, Sashi, Makuri, etc.) first-place boats use at each venue, broken down by lane.
wt.summary: Winning technique breakdown over the past 90 days
wt.note: 💡 The share is the breakdown within races won by that lane.

lt.title: 💔 Losing Technique Analysis
lt.description: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this shows for each venue and lane which technique the winner used when that lane failed to finish first.
lt.summary: Losing technique breakdown over the past 90 days
lt.note: 💡 The share is the breakdown within races where that lane failed to win. You can read tendencies such as "when boat 1 loses, it is often beaten by Sashi."

outcome.title: 📊 Trifecta Outcome Distribution
outcome.description: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this analyzes trifecta outcome patterns at each venue. See at a glance which 2nd/3rd place course combinations are most common for each winning course.
outcome.note: 💡 The rate is the probability within races won by that course. Higher payouts mean harder-to-hit patterns.

nige.title: 🏃 Outcome Distribution After a Nige Win
nige.description: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this analyzes which 2nd/3rd place course combinations appear in races won by Nige (wire-to-wire escape). Races where a boat other than boat 1 escaped are also included.
nige.summary: {{count}} Nige wins in the past 90 days
nige.summary_one: {{count}} Nige win in the past 90 days
nige.note: 💡 The rate is the probability within races that boat won by Nige. Nige wins by boats other than boat 1 tend to be rare.
nige.empty: No Nige outcome distribution data found

exTop.title: ⏲️ Fastest Exhibition Time → Win Conversion
exTop.description: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this shows which lanes tend to record the fastest exhibition (lap) time at each venue, and how often the fastest boat actually wins.
exTop.summary: Exhibition time results over the past 90 days
exTop.note: 💡 "Fastest exhibition" means recording the fastest lap time in that race (excluding ties). A lane with a high fastest rate but low win rate may be "fast in exhibition but unable to close out the race."

topStart.title: 🚀 Top Start Analysis by Lane
topStart.description: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this shows which lanes tend to record the fastest start at each venue, and how often a top start actually converts to a win.
topStart.summary: Top start results over the past 90 days
topStart.note: 💡 A top start means recording the fastest start timing in that race (excluding flying starts). A lane with a high top start rate but low win rate may "get out first but fail to win."

motor.title: 🔧 Motor Condition
motor.description: Select a race being held today to see each boat's motor top-2/top-3 rates at a glance. Click a motor you are interested in to see its trend across meets.
motor.trendEmpty: No trend data found for this motor
motor.note: 💡 Click a table row to see that motor's trend across meets. The highlighted row is the boat with the highest motor top-2 rate in this race.

racerForm.title: 📈 Racer Form
racerForm.description: Select a race being held today to compare each racer's current national win rate with their rate about 90 days ago and see whether their form is rising or falling.
racerForm.note: 💡 Click a table row to see that racer's national/local win rate trend by meet. "~90 days ago" appears only when data exists for that period. Racers with no data may be rookies or recent transfers.

formRanking.title: 🔥 Today's Hot & Cold Racers
formRanking.description: Compares the current national win rate of every racer running today with their rate about 90 days ago, and ranks the biggest movers. Unlike other tabs, you can discover notable racers across today's entire card without picking a venue or race.
formRanking.note: 💡 Click a racer's name to see details in the Racer Form tab for their race today. "~90 days ago" only includes racers with data from that period. Note that recently debuted rookies rise from a 0% win rate and easily appear in the rising ranking.

st.title: ⏱️ Exhibition vs Actual ST Gap
st.description: Select a race being held today to see how much each racer's exhibition ST has historically deviated from their actual race ST. The smaller the gap, the more "stable" the racer — their exhibition ST is a reliable reference.
st.note: 💡 Click a table row to see that racer's gap trend across past races. The highlighted row is the racer with the smallest (most stable) gap in this race. Flying starts are excluded from the gap calculation as outliers.

exTrend.title: 📈 Racer Exhibition Time Trend
exTrend.description: Select a race being held today to see how each racer's exhibition (lap) time has trended over the past 90 days. Unlike the venue/lane-based Exhibition Time tab, this tracks each racer's individual condition.
exTrend.note: 💡 Click a table row to see that racer's exhibition time trend. The highlighted row is the racer with the fastest average past exhibition time in this race. A racer whose exhibition time keeps getting slower may be losing form.

techProfile.title: 🏆 Racer Winning Technique Profile
techProfile.description: Select a race being held today to see which techniques (Nige, Sashi, Makuri, etc.) each of the six racers has used to win over the past 90 days. Unlike the venue/lane-based Winning Technique tab, this shows each racer's individual winning patterns.
techProfile.note: 💡 The breakdown is the share within races that racer won in the past 90 days. For racers with few wins, the tendency is less reliable.

returnRate.title: 💰 Racer × Boat Number ROI
returnRate.description: Select a race being held today to see each racer's Win/Place bet return rate over the past 180 days when racing from the same boat number. A perspective on whether betting on them actually pays, beyond win rates.
returnRate.note: 💡 The return rate is the total payout ratio if you had kept placing ¥100 Win/Place bets on every race from the same boat number over the past 180 days. Note that a small sample size reduces reliability.

ad.title: ⚔️ Advanced Race Data
ad.description: Select a race being held today to see each of the six racers' actual "attack" patterns from their entry course (how they attack with Sashi, Makuri, etc.) and course 1's "defense" patterns (how it gets beaten).
ad.empty: Advanced race data for this race has not been generated yet

raceCard.title: 📋 Race Card Data
raceCard.description: Select a race being held today to view the six racers' win rates, motor stats, average ST, exhibition data, and course win rates in lane order. Colored values indicate the top 3 in the race.
raceCard.note: 💡 Course win rate is wins/starts from the entry course (racerStats aggregate). Exhibition time and exhibition ST appear after the day's exhibition run.

venueRanking.title: 🏟️ Today's Venue Ranking
venueRanking.description: Ranks venues by four indicators, based only on races that have finished today. Unlike other tabs, you can discover notable venues across today's entire card without picking a venue or race.
venueRanking.empty: No races have finished today yet
venueRanking.note: 💡 Based on trifecta payout (per ¥100 stake). Venues with fewer than 3 finished races are excluded due to insufficient sample size. Treat rankings as a rough guide early in the day.

outcome.title: About Outcome Distribution
outcome.dataView: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this statistically analyzes which 2nd/3rd place combinations tend to appear at each venue when a given course finishes 1st.

tips.strong: High appearance rate
tips.text: = that combination actually appears often

tips.strong: Low payout
tips.text: = predictions tend to concentrate on it (many people bet on it)

tips.strong: High payout
tips.text: = an upset pick with a low appearance rate (harder to hit)
Each venue has different characteristics, so the appearance rate changes significantly depending on the venue you select

technique.title: About Winning Technique Analysis
technique.dataView: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this statistically analyzes which winning technique the 1st-place boat (by lane) used at each venue.

tips.strong: Lanes with a high Nige rate
tips.text: = venues/waters where an inside escape tends to succeed

tips.strong: Lanes with a high Makuri/Makuri-zashi rate
tips.text: = outer lanes tend to win, an upset-prone tendency
Each venue has different characteristics, so the tendency changes significantly depending on the venue you select

technique.articleLinkText: What is Winning Technique Analysis? A new feature to see winning patterns by venue and lane

motor.title: About Motor Condition
motor.dataView: Motor top-2/top-3 rates are updated per meet. Seeing how the same motor's results change from meet to meet helps you judge whether it is trending up or down.

tips.strong: Rising top-2/top-3 rate
tips.text: = may indicate the motor is improving after maintenance or parts replacement

tips.strong: Declining trend
tips.text: = may indicate the motor is losing form, slightly lowering reliability for that race

motor.articleLinkText: What is Motor Condition? A new feature showing today's race top-2 rate by lane

racer.title: About Racer Form
racer.dataView: Racers' national win rates are updated per period (meet). Comparing the current rate with the rate from about 90 days ago helps judge whether a racer's form is rising or falling.

tips.strong: Racers with a rising win rate
tips.text: = may be improving in form

tips.strong: Racers with a declining trend
tips.text: = even a skilled racer's reliability may need to be discounted slightly
Click a table row to drill down into that racer's national/local win rate trend by meet

racer.articleLinkText: What is Racer Form? A new feature to spot racers who are "hot right now" from national win rate changes

st.title: About Exhibition vs Actual ST Gap
st.dataView: This calculates, from each racer's past results, how much the start timing typically differs between the exhibition start (exhibition ST) and the actual race (actual ST). The smaller the gap, the more "stable" the racer — their exhibition ST is a reliable reference.

tips.strong: Racers with a small gap
tips.text: = their exhibition ST tends to be a reliable guide for the actual race

tips.strong: Racers with a large gap
tips.text: = may fall apart in the actual race even with a good exhibition, slightly lowering reliability
Click a table row to see that racer's gap trend across past races

st.articleLinkText: What is the Exhibition vs Actual ST Gap? A new feature to spot racers who are "fast in exhibition but slow off the actual start"

topstart.title: About Top Start Analysis by Lane
topstart.dataView: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this analyzes by lane, for each venue, "which lane tends to record the fastest start (top start rate)" and "how often a top start actually converts to a win (win rate after top start)."

tips.strong: Lanes with a high top start rate but low win rate
tips.text: = may tend to get out first but fail to win

tips.strong: Lanes with a high win rate after top start
tips.text: = tend to convert a fast start directly into a win
Each venue has different characteristics, so the tendency changes significantly depending on the venue you select

topstart.articleLinkText: What is Top Start Analysis by Lane? A new feature to spot lanes that merely "get out first"

losing.title: About Losing Technique Analysis
losing.dataView: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this analyzes by lane, for each venue, which technique (Nige, Sashi, Makuri, etc.) the winner used when that lane failed to finish first. It is the mirror image of Winning Technique Analysis, showing tendencies in how a lane loses.

tips.strong: Lanes with a high rate of losing to Sashi
tips.text: = tend to be passed from the inside, a weaker-holding tendency

tips.strong: Lanes with a high rate of losing to Makuri
tips.text: = tend to be weak against a charge from the outside
Seeing which technique tends to beat boat 1 helps predict how the race develops when Nige fails

losing.articleLinkText: What is Losing Technique Analysis? A new feature to spot a venue/lane's weaknesses from how it loses

nige.title: About Outcome Distribution After a Nige Win
nige.dataView: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this analyzes 2nd/3rd place appearance patterns limited to races won by "Nige" (wire-to-wire escape). Unlike Outcome Distribution (an overall tally regardless of technique), this shows tendencies specific to races decided by an escape.

tips.text: Lets you grasp which boats tend to finish 2nd/3rd when boat 1 wins by Nige
Cases where a boat other than boat 1 wins by Nige are rare and useful as a reference for upset-prone races
Comparing with the technique-agnostic Outcome Distribution lets you isolate the tendencies specific to Nige

nige.articleLinkText: What is Outcome Distribution After a Nige Win? A new feature to narrow down picks after an inside escape

extime.title: About Fastest Exhibition Time → Win Conversion
extime.dataView: Based on race results from the past 90 days, this analyzes by lane, for each venue, "which lane tends to record the fastest exhibition (lap) time" and "how often the fastest boat actually wins."

tips.strong: Lanes with a high fastest-exhibition rate but low win rate
tips.text: = may be fast in exhibition but unable to close out the race

tips.strong: Lanes with a high win rate when fastest
tips.text: = tend to convert exhibition speed directly into a win
Combine with the Exhibition vs Actual ST Gap analysis to judge exhibition reliability from multiple angles

extime.articleLinkText: What is Fastest Exhibition Time → Win Conversion? A new feature to spot the reliability of "fast in exhibition" boats

extrend.title: About Racer Exhibition Time Trend
extrend.dataView: This shows how each racer's exhibition (lap) time has trended over the past 90 days. Unlike Fastest Exhibition Time → Win Conversion (venue/lane-based), this tracks each racer's individual condition.

tips.strong: Racers whose exhibition time keeps worsening
tips.text: = may be losing form, slightly lowering reliability

tips.strong: Racers with a stable or improving exhibition time
tips.text: = may be in good shape both in motor and physical condition
Click a table row to drill down into that racer's exhibition time trend chart

extrend.articleLinkText: What is Racer Exhibition Time Trend? A new feature to read a racer's ups and downs from their exhibition time

techprofile.title: About Racer Winning Technique Profile
techprofile.dataView: This shows, as a percentage breakdown, which technique (Nige, Sashi, Makuri, etc.) each racer has used to win over the past 90 days. Unlike the venue/lane-based Winning Technique tab, this shows each racer's individual winning pattern.

tips.strong: Racers with a high Nige rate
tips.text: = the type who leads and escapes; tends to show strength from the inside lane

tips.strong: Racers with a high Makuri/Makuri-zashi rate
tips.text: = have the power to win even from an outer lane
For racers with few wins, the technique breakdown is less reliable — please keep this in mind

techprofile.articleLinkText: What is Racer Winning Technique Profile? A new feature to spot a racer's winning pattern

formranking.title: About Today's Hot & Cold Racers Ranking
formranking.dataView: For every racer running today, this compares their current national win rate with their rate from about 90 days ago and ranks the top 10 with the largest change (delta) in two lists: "Rising" and "Falling." Unlike other tabs, this lets you discover notable racers across today's entire card without selecting a venue or race.

tips.strong: Rising racers
tips.text: = recently in good form; can be used as grounds for a favorable pick

tips.strong: Falling racers
tips.text: = recently in poor form; can be used as grounds for exclusion
Click a racer's name to see details in the Racer Form tab for their race today
Note that recently debuted rookies rise from a 0% win rate and easily appear in the rising ranking

formranking.articleLinkText: What is Today's Hot & Cold Racers Ranking? A new feature to discover notable racers without picking a race

returnrate.title: About Racer × Boat Number ROI Analysis
returnrate.dataView: For each racer, this shows the total payout ratio (return rate) from continuously placing ¥100 Win/Place bets on every race over the past 180 days where that racer raced from the same boat number. It does not use the AI prediction model's probabilities — only actual paid-out amounts are tallied.

tips.strong: Racers with a high return rate
tips.text: = tend to be profitable to actually bet on, not just have a high win rate
A racer with a high win rate but low return rate may be popular, with odds concentrated low (little value)
For racers with a small sample size, the return rate is less reliable — please keep this in mind

returnrate.articleLinkText: What is Racer × Boat Number ROI Analysis? A new feature to see profitability, not just win rate

attackdefense.title: About Advanced Race Data
attackdefense.dataView: For each racer, this shows the actual distribution of "how they have attacked and won" from their entry course (attack: Sashi, Makuri, Makuri-zashi, etc.) and, for course 1 racers, "how they have been attacked and beaten" (defense). Comparing with the national average reveals a racer's attacking style.

tips.strong: Outer-lane racers with frequent Makuri attacks
tips.text: = can be a starting point for a high payout in races where the course 1 boat is weak on defense
The course 1 racer's defense distribution shows which technique tends to beat them
Combining this with the Winning Technique tab (venue/lane-based) or the Racer Winning Technique Profile tab builds up stronger grounds

racecard.title: About Race Card Data
racecard.dataView: This lists the six racers' class, win rate, motor, average ST, exhibition, and entry-course win rate in lane order. Colored values indicate the top 3 in the race. This is pure race card data, with no AI prediction score or sorting applied.

tips.strong: Racers with many colored (highlighted) values
tips.text: = rank in the top 3 across multiple metrics in the race; strong overall on the data side
A racer with a fast average ST and high ST consistency tends to have an edge in the start
The Race Data Table on the race page is a summary of analysis indicators; this tab is the raw data listing

venueranking.title: About Today's Venue Ranking
venueranking.dataView: Aggregates today's finished races by venue and ranks them by four indicators: average trifecta payout (stable/rough), boat 1's Nige success rate, and the big-payout (¥10,000+) occurrence rate.

tips.strong: Stable venues
tips.text: = boat 1's Nige tends to succeed here. Good picks for favorite-backers

tips.strong: Rough venues
tips.text: = upsets tend to happen here. Good picks for longshot-hunters
Unlike other tabs (historical trends), this tab is a real-time tally limited to today
Rankings are less reliable early in the day, when few races have finished

notice.title: ⚠️ Notes
items: This data is for reference only. Please do not base betting decisions on it alone
Patterns may change over time due to seasonal variation or weather conditions
As these are statistical tendencies, future outcomes are not guaranteed
Please always bet based on your own analysis and judgment
